mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances during periods of declining FEDFUNDS, or the average return is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.2% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of central bank rate cuts to stimulate the economy, thereby boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the mean return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in private demand, which increases the probability of fiscal or monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression of SPX returns on the interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the likelihood of central bank intervention to prevent recession, thereby lifting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to deliver positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 215.0 over a 3-month window signals accelerating inflation, prompting the central bank to maintain or raise interest rates, which increases the discount rate for equities and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in both real personal consumption (RSAFS) and GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening in aggregate demand, which increases the probability of fiscal stimulus or rate cuts, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to generate positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term has a negative or insignificant coefficient in a predictive regression (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 250,000 in a single month signals strong labor market demand, which may lead to inflationary pressures and a faster-than-expected tightening cycle, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% indicates a supply-side shock coupled with labor market weakness, which increases the likelihood of aggressive policy intervention, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.
